summary: No findings. Fairness (REQ-025): reviewEntries reads only hand.userDecisions, each holding the PlayerView that applyUserAction captured via playerView() before the action was applied. playerView copies fields by name: the user's own hole cards and the board as it was at that moment, with no deck and no other seat's hole cards. gradeView(view, action.type) receives only that view, so later streets are never used to grade earlier decisions. The panel renders view.board (a copy), the street label, the user's action label, the advice label and the grade label, all as React text. It does not render bot cards, the replay code or the deck. Deal next hand: newCode() is drawn once per click, outside the updater. The updater deals only when nextStep(t) === 'done', so a later click cannot deal a second hand. The button renders only while review !== null and the hand has a result, and the click sets review to null, which unmounts the button. Close keeps review non-null, so holdNextHand stays true. When the hand finishes, the auto-deal timer is scheduled before setReview lands; the re-render that turns holdNextHand on clears that timer, so the hold holds. No changes to package.json or the lockfile. No src file imports tests/ or test helpers, and the src diff adds no test-only hooks or globals. No storage, network, eval or innerHTML.
